subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Should OpenClaw add a public skill-source opt-out for built-in `.agents/skills` roots, and if so should it be a general disabled-source contract or a narrower personal-source toggle?
rationale: The code fix is bounded, but adding `skills.load` surface and changing built-in source behavior is compatibility-sensitive under the repository policy and needs maintainer product/API intent first.

options.title: Add a typed disabled-source list
options.body: Add a default-preserving `skills.load.disableSources`-style contract for source ids such as `agents-skills-personal`, then wire it through discovery, watchers, docs, status, and tests.

options.title: Add a narrow personal-source toggle
options.body: Expose only a personal `.agents/skills` toggle, reducing API breadth but likely leaving the same question open for project-agent and future built-in sources.

options.title: Decline new source opt-out
options.body: Keep the existing per-skill entries, agent allowlists, and prompt limits as the supported mitigation, then close this direction as not planned.

recommendation.title: Add a typed disabled-source list
recommendation.body: Add a default-preserving `skills.load.disableSources`-style contract for source ids such as `agents-skills-personal`, then wire it through discovery, watchers, docs, status, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame and adjacent personal-skills changes put this account closest to the active skills loader/config surface.
